caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a corset, centered on a plain, light beige background. The corset is rendered in shades of off-white and light gray, with detailed shading indicating folds and stitching, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The corset has a fitted bodice with wide shoulder straps, a deep rounded neckline, and a prominent waist that flares out below. Visible stitching forms distinct curved and vertical seam lines, primarily down the center, around the bust, and radiating outward from the middle, emphasizing structure and support. Small, decorative bows are positioned below the bust area on both sides and at the bottom center where a pair of thin ties hang down, further emphasizing the garment's construction. The overall appearance is symmetrical, with the left and right sides mirroring each other.
title: Corset
